title: fix(formula,lint,mcp): a fail-closed date verdict says the write is refused, and a time-relative sweep's run-fails verdict names no firing write

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEoPXTMomyUQtdV7LPhNsWK)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：两处判词改成说真话。一是失败即拒的校验规则(及字段 requiredWhen/readonlyWhen、选项 visibleWhen、hook 条件)里对日期做加减，判词不再说「字段静默得到 null」，改说「写入被拒」，新码 `date-arithmetic-fail-closed` / `date-text-arithmetic-fail-closed`。二是定时相对扫描流程的条件里文本和数字比大小，判词不再说「触发它的写入照常落库」(扫描没有写入)，改说「这一行的运行失败，别的什么都不发生」，新码 `type-mismatch-sweep-run-fails`。
- **为什么改**：两句话说的都是该位置不会发生的事：校验规则出错会拒写，不会得到 null；扫描由定时任务逐行启动，不是写入触发的。
- **风险与回滚**：分级不变，发布门不收也不放，只换文案和码。按旧码 `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` 识别失败即拒站点、按 `type-mismatch-run-fails` 识别扫描流程的使用方需改认新码。公式字段、advisory 校验规则、记录触发流程原码原句不动。回滚即 revert，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`(`dateArm` / `dateArmFault` 和 `TYPE_MISMATCH_SWEEP_ARM`)、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`(`FlowBareNames.timeRelativeSweep`)、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`(一行传键)。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.test.ts -t 30250`，预期 2 条通过：扫描流程判词不含 still lands，记录触发对照仍含；失败即拒规则的日期判词说写入被拒，公式字段对照仍说 null。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30250

Clause-②: yes (widening) — three codes join `@objectstack/formula`'s exported `ExpressionRefusalCode` / `EXPRESSION_REFUSAL_CODES` (`date-arithmetic-fail-closed`, `date-text-arithmetic-fail-closed`, `type-mismatch-sweep-run-fails`) and the optional key `timeRelativeSweep` joins the exported `ExprSchemaHint`. A fail-closed site's date verdicts move to the first two from `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic`, and a time-relative sweep's type-mismatch verdict moves to the third from `type-mismatch-run-fails` (a consumer keyed to the old codes at those sites re-keys). Grading is unchanged at every site; what is refused, warned or passed is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none — what an author can write is unchanged, and `os validate` reports no expression refusal code: its findings come from `@objectstack/lint`'s `ExprIssue` (`where`, `message`, `source`, `severity`, `path`), which carries no `code`. Only the message text changes there.
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` grep for `still lands` and `silently evaluates to null` hits `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:407` and `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json:87`, both about a record-triggered flow's null-guard edge, which still lands the write, so both stay true. The one hand-written doc sentence this PR makes false is fixed here: `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` (type-soundness row).

## What changes

Measured on `main` at `c5800818` before the change, and again after `origin/main` was merged.

**How each site learns its scope.** (1) A fail-closed site already says so: `@objectstack/lint`'s `faultOutcomeOf` ledger and MCP `validate_expression` (site `validation`) pass `faultOutcome: 'fail-closed'` at a `record`-scoped site, and a formula field passes none. So the date verdicts read it with no new signal. (2) A time-relative sweep did not say so. The ledger answers `run-fails` for a record-triggered flow and for a sweep of the typed object alike, so `@objectstack/formula` could not tell them apart. The new optional `ExprSchemaHint.timeRelativeSweep` carries that one fact. It is read only under `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'` at a `'flattened'` site.

| site | before | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| fail-closed `record` site (`error` validation rule, field `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen`, option `visibleWhen`, hook `condition`): date arithmetic | `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic`, error, "this faults at runtime, so the field silently evaluates to null." | `date-arithmetic-fail-closed` / `date-text-arithmetic-fail-closed`, error: "this faults at runtime, and here an expression that cannot be evaluated fails closed: the write (or the operation a hook guards) is refused, not skipped (it does not read null)." |
| formula field, display predicate, advisory (`warning` / `info`) validation rule: date arithmetic | `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` | unchanged, code and sentence |
| time-relative sweep of the typed object (`run-fails`): text or boolean against a number | `type-mismatch-run-fails`, error, "… the flow stops at this condition, the write that fired it still lands, and the work the flow exists to do is not done." | `type-mismatch-sweep-run-fails`, error: "… a flow condition that cannot be evaluated fails the run: the time-relative sweep starts one run per row it finds, the run for this row stops at this condition and the work the flow exists to do is not done for that row, and nothing else happens (the sweep logs the failure and goes on to the next row)." |
| record-triggered flow (`run-fails`) | `type-mismatch-run-fails` | unchanged, code and sentence |

**Why new codes.** A code names one message template (`expression-refusal.ts`, the contract), and each new sentence is a new template, as #30015 and #30016 did. The sweep sentence is read off `packages/triggers/trigger-schedule/src/time-relative-trigger.ts`: each matched row is launched with `{ record: row, event: 'time_relative' }`, and a failed run is caught per row, logged at `error` and counted, and the sweep goes on.

**The nullable-comparison sentence (`validate-null-guards.ts` `OUTCOME_CLAUSE['run-fails']`) is unchanged.** It is never served on a sweep: `validate-expressions.ts` runs the null-guard twin only where `triggerKind === 'record_change'` (`nullGuardObject`), and no other caller passes `run-fails` to `checkNullGuards` / `nullGuardMessage`. On a record-triggered flow it is true. The new lint pin asserts that no finding on a sweep says "still lands", and that the record-triggered control still does.

**Routing.** `@objectstack/lint`: `FlowBareNames` gains `timeRelativeSweep` (`triggerKind === 'time_relative'`), handed to the validator at every flow site that already gets the bare-name facts (start, edge, `decision`, inert node conditions). `@objectstack/mcp`: `validate_expression` with `site: 'flow_condition'` and `triggerKind: 'time_relative'` passes the same key, so the tool's answer stays the gate's (the gate-parity test compares messages). The date verdicts' `-run-fails` sentence already names no write, so it is served on a sweep as it is.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate.test.ts`:
  - new: a fail-closed `record` site's `record.start_date + 1 > 3` and `record.end_date - record.start_date > duration("24h")` get the `-fail-closed` codes and the refused-write sentence, and not "evaluates to null". Controls: a formula field (`value`, no outcome) and an advisory rule (`fail-open`) keep `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` and the null sentence;
  - new: `name > 5` and `record.name > 5` under `run-fails` + `timeRelativeSweep` get `type-mismatch-sweep-run-fails`, the per-row sentence, and no "still lands" / "write that fired". With no outcome the key changes nothing (`type-mismatch-run-may-fail`). A sweep's date verdict stays `date-arithmetic-run-fails`;
  - changed: the #30016 test's last control asserted that a fail-closed rule says "silently evaluates to null", which is the defect. It now asserts that a formula field keeps that sentence.
  - unchanged: `errors with the run-fails wording where the caller declares a flow condition (#29926)` (the record-triggered "still lands" pin, `:801` on `main`).
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: a `PINS` entry for each new code (exact params and message). `SWEEP_SCHEMAS` gains a fail-closed `record` schema with a date field and a flattened `run-fails` + `timeRelativeSweep` schema, so the sweep reaches all three codes and holds their params to their messages.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`:
  - new: a time-relative sweep's start condition `title > 5` gets the per-row sentence, and no finding on the flow says "still lands" (nor does the null-guard twin, which is not served there). Control: the same flow record-triggered keeps "the write that fired it still lands" on the type verdict and on the null-guard verdict of its edge;
  - new (replaces the `#30016 control`, which pinned the null sentence on a fail-closed rule): two `error` validation rules with date arithmetic say the write is refused, not null. Control: a formula field's `record.close_date + 1` keeps the null sentence;
  - changed: the #29959 / #30026 time-relative test asserted "the write that fired it still lands" on the sweep's three errors. It now asserts the per-row sentence and the absence of "still lands" / "write that fired".
  - unchanged: every record-triggered "still lands" pin.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-validate-expression.test.ts`: unchanged. Its gate-parity rows for `triggerKind: 'time_relative'` compare the tool's messages with the gate's, so they pin the MCP half (ablation A2 below).
- `packages/objectql/src/publish-type-mismatch-fail-closed.test.ts`: unchanged, 12/12 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **An advisory (`warning` / `info`) validation rule's date arithmetic still says "silently evaluates to null".** There a fault skips the rule and the write proceeds (`type-mismatch-fail-open`'s sentence), so "evaluates to null" is not true either. Out of this card's ruling (fail-closed only), left as is and pinned as a control. Reported to the seat as a finding in the same family.
- **`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` date-arithmetic row** says "this always faulted to `null`". That describes a formula's runtime, and this PR changes no runtime, so it is left as is.
- **Serial check.** The open PRs touching `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` or `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` were not enumerated by this dev (the seat's claim cleared them at 12:18Z). `origin/main` was merged once at `fc42e4af` with no conflict, and none of the 8 incoming commits touches these packages.
